Given triangle $ABC,$ there exists a unique point $P$ such that
\[AB^2 + AP^2 + BP^2 = AC^2 + AP^2 + CP^2 = BC^2 + BP^2 + CP^2.\]Express the common value above in terms of the side lengths $a,$ $b,$ and $c,$ and circumradius $R$ of triangle $ABC.$

Let $O$ be the circumcenter of triangle $ABC.$

[asy]
unitsize(0.8 cm);

pair A, B, C, O, P;

A = (0,4);
B = (-3,0);
C = (3,0);
O = (0,0);
P = extension(A, A + dir(110), B, B + dir(20));

draw(A--B--C--cycle);
draw(circumcircle(A,B,C));
draw(A--P--B);
draw(A--P--C);
draw(B--P--C);

label("$A$", A, N);
label("$B$", B, SW);
label("$C$", C, SE);
label("$O$", O, S);
label("$P$", P, NE);
[/asy]

By the Law of Cosines on triangle $ABO,$
\[BO^2 = AB^2 + AO^2 - 2 \cdot AB \cdot AO \cdot \cos \angle BAO.\]Since $AO = BO = R,$ this becomes
\[R^2 = AB^2 + R^2 - 2 \cdot AB \cdot R \cdot \cos \angle BAO.\]Then $AB \cdot R \cdot \cos \angle BAO = \frac{AB^2}{2}.$

Similarly, $AC \cdot R \cdot \cos \angle CAO = \frac{AC^2}{2}$ and $BC \cdot R \cdot \cos \angle CBO = \frac{BC^2}{2}.$

Let $x = AP^2,$ $y = BP^2,$ and $z = CP^2.$  Then
\begin{align*}
AB^2 + x + y &= AC^2 + x + z = BC^2 + y + z.
\end{align*}Hence, $AB^2 - AC^2 = z - y$ and $AC^2 - BC^2 = y - x.$

By the Law of Cosines on triangle $ABP,$
\[BP^2 = AB^2 + AP^2 - 2 \cdot AB \cdot AP \cdot \cos \angle BAP.\]Then
\[y = AB^2 + x - 2 \cdot AB \cdot AP \cdot \cos \angle BAP.\]Similarly,
\begin{align*}
z &= AC^2 + x - 2 \cdot AC \cdot AP \cdot \cos \angle CAP, \\
x &= BC^2 + y - 2 \cdot BC \cdot BP \cdot \cos \angle CBP.
\end{align*}Substituting $z - y = AB^2 - AC^2,$ we get
\[AB^2 - AC^2 = 2 \cdot AP \cdot (AC \cdot \cos \angle CAP - AB \cdot \cos \angle BAP).\]Then
\[AC \cdot \cos \angle CAP - AB \cdot \cos \angle BAP = \frac{AB^2 - AC^2}{2 \cdot AP}.\]Similarly,
\begin{align*}
BC \cdot \cos \angle CBP - AC \cdot \cos \angle CAP &= \frac{AC^2 - BC^2}{2 \cdot BP}, \\
AB \cdot \cos \angle BAP - BC \cdot \cos \angle CBP &= \frac{BC^2 - AB^2}{2 \cdot CP}.
\end{align*}Adding all three equations, we get
\[0 = \frac{AB^2 - AC^2}{2 \cdot AP} + \frac{AC^2 - BC^2}{2 \cdot BP} + \frac{BC^2 - AB^2}{2 \cdot CP}.\]Then
\[\frac{AB^2 - AC^2}{AP} + \frac{AC^2 - BC^2}{BP} + \frac{BC^2 - AB^2}{CP} = 0.\]Let $a = BC,$ $b = AC,$ and $c = AB.$  Then
\[\frac{c^2 - b^2}{AP} + \frac{b^2 - a^2}{BP} + \frac{a^2 - c^2}{CP} = 0.\]From the Law of Sines,
\[\frac{a}{\sin \angle A} = \frac{b}{\sin \angle B} = \frac{c}{\sin \angle C} = 2R.\]Then
\begin{align*}
\frac{c^2 - b^2}{AP} &= \frac{4R^2 \sin^2 C - 4R^2 \sin^2 B}{AP} \\
&= \frac{4R^2 (\sin C + \sin B)(\sin C - \sin B)}{AP} \\
&= \frac{8R^2 \sin \frac{C + B}{2} \cos \frac{C - B}{2} \cos \frac{C + B}{2} \sin \frac{C - B}{2}}{AP} \\
&= \frac{4R^2 \sin (C - B) \sin (C + B)}{AP} \\
&= \frac{4R^2 (\sin^2 C - \sin^2 B)}{AP} \\
&= \frac{4R^2 (1 - \cos^2 C - 1 + \cos^2 B)}{AP} \\
&= \frac{4R^2 (\cos^2 B - \cos^2 C)}{AP} \\
&= \frac{4R^2 (\cos B + \cos C)(\cos B - \cos C)}{AP} \\
&= \frac{-8R^2 \sin \frac{B + C}{2} \sin \frac{B - C}{2} \sin \frac{B + C}{2} \cos \frac{B - C}{2}}{AP} \\
&= \frac{-4R^2 \sin (B - C) \sin (B + C)}{AP} \\
&= \frac{-4R^2 (\sin^2 B - \sin^2 C)}{AP}.
\end{align*}Similarly,
\begin{align*}
\frac{b^2 - a^2}{BP} &= \frac{-4R^2 (\sin^2 A - \sin^2 C)}{BP}, \\
\frac{a^2 - c^2}{CP} &= \frac{-4R^2 (\sin^2 A - \sin^2 B)}{CP}.
\end{align*}Hence,
\[\frac{-4R^2 (\sin^2 A - \sin^2 C)}{AP} + \frac{-4R^2 (\sin^2 B - \sin^2 C)}{BP} + \frac{-4R^2 (\sin^2 A - \sin^2 B)}{CP} = 0.\]Then
\[\frac{\sin^2 A - \sin^2 C}{AP} + \frac{\sin^2 B - \sin^2 C}{BP} + \frac{\sin^2 A - \sin^2 B}{CP} = 0.\]Let $x = AP,$ $y = BP,$ and $z = CP.$  Then
\[\frac{\sin^2 A - \sin^2 C}{x} + \frac{\sin^2 B - \sin^2 C}{y} + \frac{\sin^2 A - \sin^2 B}{z} = 0.\]Multiplying both sides by $xyz,$ we get
\[y z (\sin^2 A - \sin^2 C) + x z (\sin^2 B - \sin^2 C) + x y (\sin^2 A - \sin^2 B) = 0.\]Then
\[(x y + y z) \sin^2 A + (x z + x y) \sin^2 B + (-x z - y z) \sin^2 C = 0.\]Since $A + B + C = 180^\circ,$ $\sin^2 C = \sin^2 (A + B) = \sin^2 A \cos^2 B + 2 \sin A \sin B \cos A \cos B + \sin^2 B \cos^2 A.$  Substituting, we get
\begin{align*}
&(x y + y z) \sin^2 A + (x z + x y) \sin^2 B \\
&\quad + (-x z - y z)(\sin^2 A \cos^2 B + 2 \sin A \sin B \cos A \cos B + \sin^2 B \cos^2 A) = 0.
\end{align*}This simplifies to
\[(x y + y z - x z - y z \cos^2 B) \sin^2 A + (x z + x y - x z \cos^2 A - y z \cos^2 A) \sin^2 B - 2 (x z + y z) \sin A \sin B \cos A \cos B = 0.\]By the Law of Cosines on triangle $ABC,$
\begin{align*}
\cos A &= \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc}, \\
\cos B &= \frac{a^2 + c^2 - b^2}{2ac}.
\end{align*}Substituting, we get
\begin{align*}
&(x y + y z - x z - y z \cdot \frac{a^2 + c^2 - b^2}{2ac}) \sin^2 A \\
&\quad + (x z + x y - x z \cdot \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc} - y z \cdot \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc}) \sin^2 B \\
&\quad - 2 (x z + y z) \sin A \sin B \cdot \frac{b^2 + c^2 - a^2}{2bc} \cdot \frac{a^2 + c^2 - b^2}{2ac} = 0.
\end{align*}Multiplying both sides by $2abc,$ we get
\begin{align*}
&(2abc xy + 2abc yz - 2abc xz - abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)) \sin^2 A \\
&\quad + (2abc xz + 2abc xy - acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) - abyz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \sin^2 B \\
&\quad - (x z + y z) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \sin A \sin B = 0.
\end{align*}Since $\sin^2 A = 1 - \cos^2 A = 1 - \frac{(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2}{4b^2 c^2}$ and $\sin^2 B = 1 - \cos^2 B = 1 - \frac{(a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2}{4a^2 c^2},$ this becomes
\begin{align*}
&(2abc xy + 2abc yz - 2abc xz - abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)) \left( 1 - \frac{(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2}{4b^2 c^2} \right) \\
&\quad + (2abc xz + 2abc xy - acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) - abyz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \left( 1 - \frac{(a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2}{4a^2 c^2} \right) \\
&\quad - (x z + y z) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \sin A \sin B = 0.
\end{align*}We can write
\begin{align*}
&(2abc xy + 2abc yz - 2abc xz - abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)) \left( 1 - \frac{(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2}{4b^2 c^2} \right) \\
&\quad + (2abc xz + 2abc xy - acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) - abyz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \left( 1 - \frac{(a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2}{4a^2 c^2} \right) \\
&= (2abc xy + 2abc yz - 2abc xz - abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)) \\
&\quad + (2abc xz + 2abc xy - acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) - abyz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \\
&\quad - \frac{1}{4} (ayz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + bxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \frac{(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2}{b^2 c^2} \\
&\quad - \frac{1}{4} (ayz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) + bxz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)) \frac{(a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2}{a^2 c^2} \\
&= 4abc xy + 4abc yz - 4abc xz - 2abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) - 2acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) \\
&\quad - \frac{1}{4} (ayz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + bxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \cdot \frac{(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2 + (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}Hence,
\begin{align*}
&4abc xy + 4abc yz - 4abc xz - 2abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) - 2acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) \\
&\quad - \frac{1}{4} (ayz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + bxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \cdot \frac{(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2 + (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2}{b^2 c^2} \\
&\quad - (x z + y z) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \sin A \sin B = 0.
\end{align*}Then
\begin{align*}
&(x z + y z) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \sin A \sin B \\
&= 4abc xy + 4abc yz - 4abc xz - 2abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) - 2acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) \\
&\quad - \frac{1}{4} (ayz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + bxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \cdot \frac{(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2 + (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}We can write
\begin{align*}
&(b^2 + c^2 - a^2)^2 + (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)^2 \\
&= 2a^4 + 2b^4 + 2c^4 - 2a^2 b^2 - 2a^2 c^2 - 2b^2 c^2 \\
&= 2(a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2).
\end{align*}Hence,
\begin{align*}
&(x z + y z) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \sin A \sin B \\
&= 4abc xy + 4abc yz - 4abc xz - 2abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) - 2acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) \\
&\quad - \frac{1}{2} (ayz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + bxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}By the Law of Sines,
\[\sin A \sin B = \frac{a}{2R} \cdot \frac{b}{2R} = \frac{ab}{4R^2}.\]Then
\begin{align*}
&(x z + y z) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \cdot \frac{ab}{4R^2} \\
&= 4abc xy + 4abc yz - 4abc xz - 2abyz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) - 2acxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) \\
&\quad - \frac{1}{2} (ayz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + bxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}Multiplying both sides by $4R^2,$ we get
\begin{align*}
&(x z + y z) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) ab \\
&= 16abcR^2 xy + 16abcR^2 yz - 16abcR^2 xz - 8abyzR^2 (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \\
&\quad - 8acxzR^2 (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) - 2R^2 (ayz (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + bxz (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}Let $k = AB^2 + AP^2 + BP^2 = AC^2 + AP^2 + CP^2 = BC^2 + BP^2 + CP^2.$  Then $x + y + c^2 = x + z + b^2 = y + z + a^2 = k.$  Solving, we find $x = \frac{k - b^2 + c^2}{2},$ $y = \frac{k - a^2 + c^2}{2},$ and $z = \frac{k - a^2 + b^2}{2}.$  Substituting, we get
\begin{align*}
&\left( \frac{k - a^2 + b^2}{2} \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + c^2}{2} + \frac{k - a^2 + b^2}{2} \cdot \frac{k - b^2 + c^2}{2} \right) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) ab \\
&= 16abcR^2 \cdot \frac{k - b^2 + c^2}{2} \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + c^2}{2} + 16abcR^2 \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + c^2}{2} \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + b^2}{2} \\
&\quad - 16abcR^2 \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + b^2}{2} \cdot \frac{k - b^2 + c^2}{2} - 8abR^2 \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + b^2}{2} (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \\
&\quad - 8acR^2 \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + c^2}{2} (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) \\
&\quad - 2R^2 \left( ab \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + b^2}{2} (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) + ac \cdot \frac{k - a^2 + c^2}{2} (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) \right) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}This simplifies to
\begin{align*}
&(k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) ab \\
&= 4abcR^2 (k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) - 2abR^2 (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)(k - a^2 + b^2) \\
&\quad - 2acR^2 (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(k - a^2 + c^2) \\
&\quad - R^2 (ab (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) (k - a^2 + b^2) + ac (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) (k - a^2 + c^2)) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}Then
\begin{align*}
&ab (k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \\
&= 4abcR^2 (k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) - 2abR^2 (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)(k - a^2 + b^2) \\
&\quad - 2acR^2 (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(k - a^2 + c^2) \\
&\quad - R^2 (ab (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) (k - a^2 + b^2) + ac (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) (k - a^2 + c^2)) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c^2}.
\end{align*}Dividing both sides by $ab,$ we get
\begin{align*}
&(k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \\
&= 4cR^2 (k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) - 2R^2 (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)(k - a^2 + b^2) \\
&\quad - 2cR^2 (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(k - a^2 + c^2) \\
&\quad - R^2 (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) (k - a^2 + b^2) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c} \\
&\quad - R^2 (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) (k - a^2 + c^2) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b c^2}.
\end{align*}Then
\begin{align*}
&(k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(a^2 + c^2 - b^2) \\
&= 4cR^2 (k^2 - (a^2 - b^2)(a^2 - c^2)) - 2R^2 (a^2 + c^2 - b^2)(k - a^2 + b^2) \\
&\quad - 2cR^2 (b^2 + c^2 - a^2)(k - a^2 + c^2) \\
&\quad - R^2 (a^2 + c^2 - b^2) (k - a^2 + b^2) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b^2 c} \\
&\quad - R^2 (b^2 + c^2 - a^2) (k - a^2 + c^2) \cdot \frac{a^4 + b^4 + c^4 - a^2 b^2 - a^2 c^2 - b^2 c^2}{b c^2}.
